# Shastra AI

        > AI technology company (Bangalore + Kent) helping brands build, market, and scale using AI across strategy, creative, and product.

        Shastra AI is a unit of Hridtech Private Limited, a Bengaluru-based venture builder. Founded by Sanket Anil Joshi.

        ## What we do
        - AI Build: websites, apps, internal tools, automations, AI agents
        - Creative & Content: AI-assisted campaigns, content, design systems
        - Performance Marketing: AI-driven paid media across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok
        - Brand & Strategy: positioning, naming, identity, narrative

        ## Who we work with
        Challenger brands, established brands modernising, PE/growth-equity operators, and cross-border launches between India, UAE, UK, and US.

        ## Offices
        - India: Bangalore
        - UK: Kent
